description: Hi I’m Shaikha Al Kaabi,  I am a 13-year-old student participating as an individual I created AstroBricks AI, a hands-on learning project that combines aLEGO lunar base with an interactive app I designed the project to help children explore space missions by building,learning about  station through NFC tags, and making choices during 8day lunar mission.My project focuses on managing resources and helping children understand how their decisions  affect an astronaut’s safety and mission’s success.
